{{Top|notoc=1}}
[[File:Senya_Tirall_in_a_coma.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Senya Tirall lies in a coma.]]
A '''coma''' was a debilitating effect on beings that completely disabled them and left them in a completely unconscious, near-[[Death/Legends|death]] state. A person in a coma was described as '''comatose'''. Comas could be triggered by severe injury, toxins or drugs, or could be intentionally entered by certain [[Species/Legends|species]], such as the [[Gand/Legends|Gand]],<ref name="AS:DotBH">''[[Aurra Sing: Dawn of the Bounty Hunters]]''</ref> and by certain [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. [[Moonglow]] was known to produce a [[Hallucination/Legends|hallucinatory]] coma followed by death.

==Notable examples==
*[[Revan/Legends|Revan]] was rendered comatose when he was [[Capture of Darth Revan|betrayed]] by [[Darth Malak]], allowing the Jedi to capture him.
*The [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] was put in a coma by a heavy dose of sedatives while traveling aboard the [[Harbinger (Hammerhead-class)|''Harbinger'']].
*[[Senya Tirall]] fell into a coma after using the [[Voss healing ritual]] to save her son [[Arcann]].
*[[Kira Carsen]] and [[Scourge (Sith)|Sith]] were comatose for over a year after destroying [[Tenebrae]]'s original body, unleashing [[Tenebrae's curse]].
*[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Satele Shan]] and [[Satele Shan's followers|her team]] of Jedi fell into a coma after rescuing Kira Carsen and Scourge, becoming afflicted by Tenebrae's curse that still lingered in the air.
*[[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]] fell into a possibly self-induced coma.
*Following a severe [[Brain/Legends|head]] injury he [[Battle of Gaftikar|sustained]] on [[Gaftikar]], the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] known as [[Fi Skirata|Fi]] fell into a coma, a state he remained in for weeks while [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bardan Jusik]] made use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Force healing/Legends|heal]] him. Fi eventually awoke from his coma due to Jusik's efforts, though he required further treatment and physical therapy to continue his recovery.<ref name="TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>
*[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] force-choked [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|his own wife]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] after he discovered that [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] had followed her. When Vader released her on Kenobi's orders, she fell into a coma.
*[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] experienced a coma on [[Panna/Legends|Panna]] as a result of a [[sleeping virus]], and after an attack by [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]].
*The [[Myrkr strike team]] used [[coma gas]] to put their would-be [[Yuuzhan Vong]] captors in a comatose state.
*[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] gave [[Ta'a Chume]] a brain hemorrhage that led to a coma.
*[[Darth Maladi]] was found in a comatose state by the [[Empire-in-exile]] resulting in her capture.
